position_end: The health-insurance strand moved out of its seven pilot communes into a generalisation phase covering fourteen more, enrolling against the national identification register
note: the pilot strand had run since 29 July 2019

subject: include.access
name: Citizen feedback channels
position_end: The national services portal carries suggestion and problem-reporting functions, a free police line opened, and a national living-environment platform launched
note: No volume of feedback received or resolved is published for any of the three

subject: include.access
name: Consumer redress for failed mobile-money transactions
milestone: National complaints platform announced 2026-01-16 for launch by end-March 2026
position_end: The financial-services quality observatory presented an online complaints portal on 2025-07-29 and in January 2026 announced a national complaints platform for launch by the end of March 2026, supervised by the state digital agency and financed by Luxembourg cooperation; no launch is on record
note: complaints about failed transactions and a new financial-sector consumer-redress body

subject: include.access
name: Corruption complaints platform and free line 155
position_start: No position held at the window's opening
position_end: A presidential complaints cell created by décret 2022-040 of 19 January 2022 receives reports of corruption and mismanagement through the denonciation.bj platform and the free number 155, declared operational in December 2022; no caseload is published
note: the cell sits in the presidency

subject: include.access
name: Digital access to public services
position_end: At least 75% of identification services accessed digitally (2025)
sources: 2026-02-02 Benin reports 75% of identification services accessed through digital platforms
note: at least 75% of identification services accessed digitally in 2025; the unconnected are served by a USSD channel and by in-person windows

subject: include.access
name: Disability targeting platform
position_end: Parameters defined with a disability organisation for a targeting platform under the inclusion project; the platform itself is not built

subject: include.access
name: Equal-opportunity card for persons with disabilities
milestone: 1,422 cards handed to the social-action ministry 2026-09-18
position_end: Issued by the identification agency ANIP under Loi 2017-06, which ties rights in health, education, employment and transport to the card: 4,718 distributed in 2024 and 2025, 1,422 more handed over in September 2026 and about 4,000 applications registered for 2026
note: the medical certificate that establishes eligibility is the bottleneck named by the ministry and the disability federation

subject: include.access
name: Fon-language voice AI
position_end: Development of the first voice-to-voice AI model in Fon under way at a regional lab co-led by Benin, Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire
note: development of the first voice-to-voice AI model in Fon, for mother-tongue service access, at a Gates Foundation-supported regional lab co-led by the digital ministries of Benin, Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, with a prototype due within nine months — the inclusion mechanism the rest of the francophone material lacks

subject: include.access
name: Free identity-card distribution by civil society
milestone: More than 130,000 cards across nine communes (2026-05)
position_end: 130,000+ free cards in eight months, exposing failed fingerprints and dead enrolment numbers
note: an NGO issued more than 130,000 free cards across nine communes in eight months on an electoral-participation rationale, which also exposed the gap between the earlier enrolment campaign and card issuance — failed fingerprints and dead enrolment numbers

subject: include.access
name: Gender equity instruments
position_end: The 2013 gender-equality council stands and a women's entrepreneurship and access-to-finance project was announced; neither publishes a digital gender gap

subject: include.access
name: Identity documentation of refugees and asylum-seekers
milestone: UNHCR semester figures to end June 2026
position_start: No position held at the window's opening
position_end: 16,463 recognised refugees held no valid identity card and about 12,400 asylum-seekers awaited formal registration at end June 2026, among 42,840 refugees and asylum-seekers; UNHCR and the authorities are working on biometric integration of those concerned into the national register of natural persons and extending civil-registration single windows; refugee status is governed by Law 2022-31 and a national commission reorganised by decree 2024-1362
note: figures are UNHCR's factsheet as a news site reports it

subject: include.access
name: Loi 2017-06 on the rights of persons with disabilities
position_start: No position held at the window's opening
position_end: In force across 79 articles: it creates the equal-opportunity card that ties rights in health, education, training, employment, communication and transport to its holder, sets accessibility duties for the built environment and transport, protects the confidentiality of health data and carries penalties
note: the adopted text; its implementing decrees are not held

subject: include.access
name: Mobile data pricing
position_end: 995 FCFA a gigabyte (2023), from 4,000 in 2016
note: data prices fell from 4,000 to 995 FCFA a gigabyte between 2016 and 2023

subject: include.access
name: Online referral to the Médiateur de la République
position_start: No position held at the window's opening
position_end: The national ombudsman launched online referral on 14 November 2023 at the presentation of its 2022 report, which recorded 697 complaints; no online volume is published

subject: include.access
name: Treasury client listening centre
milestone: Presented at the treasury's reform session 2025-02-28
position_start: No position held at the window's opening
position_end: The treasury's complaints centre takes complaints by telephone, e-mail, web form and at a physical counter; digitising and automating complaint handling is named as a next step
note: no complaint volume is published

subject: include.divides

milestone: 43 points and 43 hotspots in service, April 2021
position_start: No position held at the window's opening
position_end: 43 community digital points, charging 150 FCFA an hour, and 43 free WiFi hotspots brought into service across the country by the universal-service agency in April 2021, offering internet access, digital content and training
note: no later count or usage figure is held; the integrated centres approved in September 2026 each include a community digital point

subject: include.divides
name: Digital usage growth

note: the regulator's 2025 report records rising digital usage alongside the mobile-money figures; no disaggregation by gender or rurality is carried in the held account

subject: include.divides
name: Integrated rural digital transformation project (PITN2R)
position_start: No position held at the window's opening
position_end: A five-year World Bank-financed project of US$47.2m launched in December 2020 to extend broadband to 2,128 villages in Alibori, Borgou, Donga, Atacora and Collines and to promote digital tools in agricultural value chains, financial inclusion and market access; no coverage result is held
note: the launch announcement only

subject: data.statistics

subject: data.statistics

milestone: Main census mapping began in 74 communes 2024-03-19
position_end: Census mapping under way: trainers taught in January 2024 after a three-commune pilot, and main mapping started on 19 March 2024 in the remaining 74 communes with tablet-equipped agents, planned for two months
note: no enumeration date or result is held

subject: data.statistics

position_end: Living-conditions survey indicators published, the first national time-use survey released, and the fourth population census results standing

position_end: The statistics institute's fifteenth yearbook since 2008, for 2024, pools sixteen chapters of 2019-2024 tables from across the national statistical system, from education, health and justice to the civil service, energy and water

subject: data.statistics
name: Loi 2022-07 organising statistical activity
position_end: In force as the statute organising and regulating statistical activity, replacing the earlier regime

subject: data.statistics

milestone: FAO technical assistance for preparation and execution
position_end: A national agricultural census under preparation with Food and Agriculture Organization technical assistance for its preparation and execution
note: the record is an IATI activity; no fieldwork date or budget is stated

subject: data.statistics
name: National statistics office as data custodian
position_end: Named among four offices being displaced as primary data producers (2026-03)
sources: 2026-03-11 The evolving role of National Statistics Offices (NSOs) as data custodians in the digital age
note: named among four case studies of offices being displaced as primary data producers by platform, satellite and privately held data; the report recommends legal reform to formalise the custodian role

subject: data.statistics
name: Public reporting of exchange usage
position_end: Request volumes, members, systems and services published

subject: data.statistics
name: Statistical development strategy
position_end: A national development plan to 2035 approved with its own monitoring indicators, which the next statistical strategy will have to support; no current strategy document is held

subject: data.open
name: Budget transparency
position_end: Open Budget Survey 2025: 77/100 transparency, 52 participation, 72 oversight
note: Open Budget Survey 2025 scores of 77/100 on transparency — 5th globally and 2nd in sub-Saharan Africa — 52/100 on participation and 72/100 on oversight, from 1/100 in 2012; a reference survey, cited and not absorbed

subject: data.open
name: Open Government Partnership national action plan
position_end: The budget directorate published the co-creation roadmap for the first national action plan on 14 August 2026: a 38-activity matrix naming for each step the responsible body, its partners, the funding source and an indicative deadline, running from the founding ministerial order that established the national committee in June 2025 through a preparatory phase, a departmental consultation phase and adoption of the plan, to documentation of the process after December 2026. Access to information, and digital governance for inclusion and digital rights, are named among the plan's four pillars, and activity 32 commits the government to publishing a what-we-heard, what-was-kept-and-why report alongside a matrix of reasoned responses. The plan itself is not adopted
note: the roadmap document is now held in full, settling the traceability mechanism the press coverage described only in general terms; what remains unheld is any output of the process - no consultation record, commitment text or adoption date is published

subject: data.open
name: Statistics institute open-data portal and NADA microdata catalogue
milestone: Access terms set out in the 2024 database inventory
position_end: The institute's website carries two data platforms, an open-data indicator portal free to all at any hour and a NADA microdata catalogue, with access to survey and census databases listed in its 2024 inventory granted on request

subject: data.satellite

position_end: A regional information-society conference and an Africa-Connect digital campus; no bilateral digital instrument with Benin is held
